searchText: What should be done in order to merge this PR: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/598 we got the changes.md merge conflicts again, if this is resolved we can merge it, or do we need more feedback? if anyone is opposed to that change they should let us know, otherwise, i think it's pretty straightforward and we can merge it i resolved the conflict will merge EOD do you think the PR makes sense in general? I mean that the event itself makes sense and will be used by anyone good question, so the consumer will mostly be exchanges, bridges (potentially), wallets? I am just wondering, do they listen to CL or just check safe block hash on EL? at the very minimum, this event seems useful to test FCR yes, potentially. Maybe some bridges need confirmed beacon block not the payload, and there seem to be no way to request it atm does the EL have a event/push based mechanism like that? yes, and for gathering some performance metrics over mainnet. Also, if impl has a flag to enable FCR this event will only be emitted when the flag is enabled i suppose and doesn't produce any overhead when disabled i don't think that JSON-RPC API has push mechanism yeah agree, the event is the very minimal and opt-in, should be uncontroversial to have this in the spec personally like that way of consuming FCR from the beacon node
